description: This script generates and tests various CRL (Certificate Revocation List) data structures, including creating certificates, signing CRLs, and testing different invalid and edge cases for CRL parsing and validation.

methods.name: DictUnion
methods.description: Combines two dictionaries into one, merging items.

methods.name: Der2Ascii
methods.description: Converts DER-encoded data to ASCII using an external 'der2ascii' tool.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII data to DER using an external 'ascii2der' tool.

methods.name: Ascii2OpensslDer
methods.description: Converts ASCII to DER and formats as OpenSSL DER string.

methods.name: CreateCert
methods.description: Creates an X.509 certificate with specified parameters, signs it, and returns certificate and key objects.

methods.name: SignAsciiCRL
methods.description: Signs a CRL with a given signer, producing a DER-encoded CRL.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Encodes DER data into PEM format with headers and footers.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes string data to a specified file path.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores CRL and certificate data into a PEM file with associated metadata.
